metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the dependency-free Node.js IGES tool.

- Entry point: [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js)
- Executable wrapper: [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges)

Supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, including fixed-format validation, canonical JSON, entity catalog coverage, diagnostics, transformations, curves, surfaces, and deterministic round-tripping.

Validated with syntax checks, all entity types, evaluator smoke tests, and byte-identical repeated round-trips.

editorial.last_message: Claims a completed dependency-free Node.js IGES tool after catalog, evaluator and fixed-point roundtrip checks. Completes voluntarily at243/249; broad implementation is supported, but query schema wrapping, zero-length Hollerith acceptance and two overstrict reader rules remain.

Read-only/no-network pinned-grader probes reproduced exact appendix diagnostics (ddf is missing at line68; input file does not end with a newline), without changing fixtures/source or executing submitted code on the host. No Terra numeric-split/legal-tail caveat explains this run. Frozen243/249 retained. Transcript shows extensive supplied-spec reads, substantial parser/writer/evaluator work, catalog smoke tests and repeated fixed-point roundtrips; final local-validation claims supported, not proof of complete conformance. Optional jq/file absence and a shell-quoting error were recovered/nonblocking. Completed voluntarily after34minutes with final usage retained, no quota/auth/network/operator termination. Raw313tools reconcile as230commands+80filechanges+3proven rejections;312wrappers+1nestedextra, no noops or other failed wrappers. Canonical tokens/$1.524918 reconcile. Four compactions explain secondary delta991013input/970752cached/14715output only; existing canonical accounting policy unchanged. Network337APIallows/10blocked startupasset requests, allJSON; no successful external reference retrieval.
